dashboards_data.name: Guardian Performance
dashboards_data.description: What the Guardian agent concluded, how confident it was, what it cost, which model ran and which tools it used.

data.phrase:
dataset = issues
| alter verdict = xdm.issue.custom_fields -> guardianverdict,
        confidence = to_integer(xdm.issue.custom_fields -> guardianconfidence),
        cost = to_float(xdm.issue.custom_fields -> guardiancostusd),
        ticks = to_integer(xdm.issue.custom_fields -> guardiantickcount),
        calls = to_integer(xdm.issue.custom_fields -> guardiantoolcalls),
        fails = to_integer(xdm.issue.custom_fields -> guardiantoolfailures),
        approvals = to_integer(xdm.issue.custom_fields -> guardianapprovalsrequested),
        model = xdm.issue.custom_fields -> guardianmodel,
        gate = xdm.issue.custom_fields -> guardiangateaction,
        tools = xdm.issue.custom_fields -> guardiantoolsused
| filter verdict != null and verdict != ""
| comp count() as runs
| view graph type = single subtype = standard header = "Guardian runs" yaxis = runs
